workflow.name: Codebase Investigation
workflow.trigger: understand, explore, how does this work, explain, map out, trace, analyze codebase
workflow.description: Analysis and documentation of existing systems without modification.

step.goal: Map system structure: components, data flows, dependencies. Document key patterns and conventions in use. Identify entry points, hot paths, and critical sections.
Identify technical debt, risks, and improvement opportunities. Note deviations from best practices.
